summary: Batch image resizing, format conversion, watermarking, and metadata tools.

recipes.label: Batch Resize
recipes.description: Resize every image in a folder and save the results to a new folder, leaving the originals untouched.
recipes.template: for f in {sourceFolder}/*; do magick "$f" -resize {size} {destination}/"$(basename "$f")"; done

recipes.label: Convert Format
recipes.description: Convert every image in a folder to a different file format.
recipes.template: for f in {sourceFolder}/*; do magick "$f" {destination}/"$(basename "${f%.*}").{format}"; done

recipes.label: Add Watermark
recipes.description: Overlay a watermark image onto every image in a folder.
recipes.template: for f in {sourceFolder}/*; do magick "$f" {watermarkImage} -gravity {gravity} -composite {destination}/"$(basename "$f")"; done

recipes.label: Strip Metadata
recipes.description: Remove EXIF/IPTC/XMP metadata from every image in a folder, useful before sharing photos publicly.
recipes.template: for f in {sourceFolder}/*; do magick "$f" -strip {destination}/"$(basename "$f")"; done

recipes.label: Contact Sheet
recipes.description: Build a single contact-sheet image tiling thumbnails of every image in a folder.

availableOptions.label: Resize
availableOptions.description: Resize using a percentage (e.g. 50%) or WxH pixel dimensions.

availableOptions.label: Quality
availableOptions.description: Set output quality for lossy formats like JPEG (1-100).

availableOptions.label: Rotate
availableOptions.description: Rotate the image by a number of degrees.

availableOptions.label: Crop
availableOptions.description: Crop to WxH pixels starting at an X,Y offset.

availableOptions.label: Gravity / Position
availableOptions.description: Anchor point used by crop/composite operations (e.g. center, southeast).

availableOptions.label: Blur
availableOptions.description: Apply a Gaussian blur, given as radius x sigma (e.g. 0x8).
